messages:
Maya: FYI nightly DAST failed auth after the infra role cleanup. Nightly job got 401s at 00:12. Anyone awake?
Samir: Which principal does DAST use in staging?
Maya: `dast-runner` with token in `staging/dast/sa-token`, KMS key `sdlc-dast-key`.
Alex: I merged infra tidy-up last night (PR #482) and removed some legacy bindings. Did I accidentally strip decrypter rights?
Leo: Checking logs:
```
2026-03-21T00:11:58Z KMS decrypt PERMISSION_DENIED for sdlc-dast-key (version 3)
2026-03-21T00:12:01Z iam: serviceAccount:dast-runner denied iam.serviceAccounts.get
```
Samir: Looks like the key rotated and the `dast-runner` binding wasn't applied.
Maya: Two options: re-add decrypter to `dast-runner` or revert the PR. Fast fix vs audit-friendly revert.
security-bot: Reminder: any KMS/IAM change needs Jira SEC-1307 annotation and audit log entry.
Leo: Re-added binding with gcloud command and verified decrypts resumed. Nightly progressed past login.
Alex: I'll update the infra PR to include explicit `dast-runner` decrypter role and document rotation impacts (PR #491).
Samir: Also open a suppression audit if SAST false positives show up during the flush. Track reviewer and evidence.
Maya: Action items: Leo posted KMS fix, Alex updates PR+README, Samir files audit entry. I'll annotate SEC-1307 timeline. Closing once PR #491 + SEC audit exist. :thumbsup:
